subject: Verizon 5G Installation Regulations
overview: The Council addressed public health and environmental concerns regarding 5G deployment by passing several resolutions requesting state and federal intervention and initiating a local ordinance process. The body also established legislative priorities for 2020 and advocated for evening meeting times for all boards and commissions to improve public accessibility.

items.title: Max Stevens Citation
items.summary: The Council presented a citation to Max Stevens in recognition of his gold medal win in the Hockey Deaf Olympics in Italy.

items.title: Verizon 5G Installation and Regulation
items.summary: Approved several resolutions requesting that state and federal officials study the health effects of 5G and amend the Telecommunications Act of 1996 to account for health impacts. The Council also scheduled a future public meeting with stakeholders to develop a local ordinance and established a desire for independent health studies and stricter notification requirements for installations.

items.title: 2020 Census Outreach Plans
items.summary: Referred to the Committee of the Whole a request for the administration to present its strategy for ensuring an accurate and inclusive 2020 census count.

items.title: Carol Clements Retirement and Condolences
items.summary: Congratulated Carol Clements on her retirement after 40 years of service and offered condolences to the families of Theresa Roberti and Gerard Edouard.

items.title: Support for NIP Bottle Deposit Legislation
items.summary: Approved sending a letter to the state delegation supporting House Bill 2881, which would require a five-cent deposit on 'nip' liquor bottles to mitigate litter.

items.title: Crosswalk Maintenance and Board Meeting Times
items.summary: Requested that the DPW repaint a crosswalk at City Hall Mall and approved a resolution asking for an executive order prohibiting boards and commissions from meeting before 6:00 p.m. on weekdays.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Report and Minutes
items.summary: Approved a report detailing 2020 priorities including budget transparency, inclusionary zoning, and pedestrian safety; approved minutes from the January 14, 2020 meeting.
